title: Body Aware Physics based movement controller
author: Valentinevandal1986
selftext:
So I’m currently in the middle of a 13h and counting gauntlet with Sol 6.1 working on an entirely new ai movement controller. 

What’s different about it?

I got the idea to combine robotics movement research with in game pathfinder ai to try to build the equivalent of a robot in a digital world. The body controller is working out balance and joint and limb control, predicting where it will be, and correcting on the fly for balance and traversal. The goal is to develop a controller that can read the level geometry and decide based on a humanoid frame, where it can safely navigate through the level. It uses a combination of egocentric vision and caching to determine the route and then calculates whether its current body can complete it successfully. The animations run Nvidia Motionbricks to inform the realistic looking movements, then the system readjusts based on changes in its position, balance, orientation and whether its goal has moved. The idea is to set a destination in a novel environment, drop the ai controller into it and then have it autonomously navigate to that space but in a realistic looking way. So a 4ft tall character can’t climb a 10ft wall but a 7ft tall character could. 

This would create novel gameplay. Every movement would account for inertia, balance, angle and velocity. Swinging on your back foot would be entirely different than swinging with your feet planted. The player controller and ai controller would essentially be operating under the same constraints so the goal is to have the player and ai character to look indistinguishable from each other from an outside observers perspective. 

Currently the AI is passing walking and jogging and can hurdle a small wall and complete its run to a destination, running is still proving to be trickier. 

Overall I believe this will create dynamic enemies with unpredictable route planning and less predictable combat scenarios. There’s going to be a lot of fine tuning work to have it mimic human reaction times and to ensure it’s capturing realistic human movements but I think this is an entity new frontier in traversal and route planning for video game ai. It’s body aware ai movement without predetermined animations controlling the movements but rather machine learning and reinforcement teaching it how to walk and move like a human.

comments.author: Valentinevandal1986
comments.body: Update: 37 hours straight now. The AI can walk and vault in its environment with bodily awareness (no sliding, contorted joints). Testing is still refining moves but we’re making progress
